answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 12868 Country: India Title: If we travel for UMRA , some ulema says in one visit we can do one UMRA only and some says we can go to Masjid e AAISHA and make new ehram and we can do what ever time we want, which is correct view? Question: If we travel for UMRA , some ulema says in one visit we can do one UMRA only and some says we can go to Masjid e AAISHA and make new ehram and we can do what ever time we want, which is correct view? Answer ID: 12868 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1167/909=H/1430) While staying in Makkah Mukarramah, one can perform umrah as much as one wishes by wearing ihram from Masjid Ayishah, but the ihram for next umrah should be worn only after being completely halal from previous ihram i.e. after performing tawaf, sa?ee and halaq. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
